items.title: yohey-w/multi-agent-shogun
items.summary: Samurai-inspired multi-agent system for Claude Code. Orchestrate parallel AI tasks via tmux with shogun → karo → ashigaru hierarchy. Uses tmux for isolation instead of git worktrees. Claude Code specific.

items.title: tzone85/vortex-dispatch
items.summary: AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) ship merged PRs. Decomposes work, runs stories in parallel git worktrees with per-story ephemeral Postgres. 5-tier failure escalation. Event-sourced. Go implementation.

items.title: mcdays94/pocock-agents
items.summary: Pair of OpenCode agents implementing Matt Pocock's skill-driven workflow as grill/plan/dispatch pipeline with parallel TDD workers on git worktrees. OpenCode-specific. TDD-focused. No error classification.

items.title: mrap/boi
items.summary: Dispatch TOML specs to parallel Claude Code agents with DAG dependencies, isolated git worktrees, and machine-verified gates. Written in Go. Claude Code specific. Likely inspired by taskfleet.

items.title: first-fluke/oh-my-agent
items.summary: Multi-agent harness that checks the work via artifact-based verification (stop-hook gates, independent judges, append-only event logs). Supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 10+ runtimes.

items.title: omnigent-ai/omnigent
items.summary: Open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness. Orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents. Swap harnesses without rewriting. Enforce policies and sandboxing.

items.title: cft0808/edict
items.summary: 9 specialized AI agents with real-time dashboard, model config, and full audit trails. OpenClaw Multi-Agent Orchestration System.

items.title: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent
items.summary: TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Coordinator plans the task DAG at runtime and runs on any LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, local).

items.title: unohee/OpenSwarm
items.summary: Autonomous AI dev team orchestrator powered by Claude Code CLI. Discord control, Linear integration, cognitive memory.

items.title: massgen/MassGen
items.summary: Multi-agent scaling system running in terminal. Autonomously orchestrates frontier models and agents to collaborate, reason, and produce high-quality results.

items.title: first-fluke/oh-my-agent
items.summary: SmythOS Runtime Environment (SRE) — open-source, cloud-native runtime for agentic AI. Secure, modular, production-ready agent management across local, cloud, and edge.

items.title: zeynepyorulmaz/openclaw-orchestrator
items.summary: Adaptive multi-agent orchestration framework. Break down complex goals into parallel tasks, route to specialized LLM agents, iterate with real-time web dashboard. TypeScript, Zod-validated, SQLite-backed.

items.title: Vibe-Skills
items.summary: General-purpose Skill that automatically routes local Skills and intelligently orchestrates harness workflows.

items.title: swarmclawai/swarmclaw
items.summary: Open-source self-hosted AI agent runtime and multi-agent framework. Agent memory, MCP tools, schedules, delegation, and 23+ LLM providers.

items.title: framerslab/agentos
items.summary: TypeScript AI agent framework with cognitive memory, runtime tool forging, multi-agent orchestration, and 11 LLM providers.

items.title: enchanter-ai/sylph
items.summary: Zero-touch Git orchestration. AI autonomously manages parallel branches, segments tasks, writes Conventional Commits, and opens clean PRs.

items.title: beastlabai/multi-llm-plugin
items.summary: Multi-LLM orchestration plugin for Claude Code. Parallel plan review, task generation, implementation, and code review across 12 coding harnesses (Codex, Cursor, opencode, pi, aider...).
